title: Aloha Goats! On the Farm with Southern Charm
description:
Charming Farmhouse style Barndominium, welcome to tranquility!

Enjoy a view of Nigerian Dwarf goats & seasonal playful, baby goats. 
Gorgeous sunset views and large fire pit.

Near 2 Lakes (Percy Priest & Old Hickory), Catch the Thrills of the Super Speedway Race Track, Golf, or stay for seamless travel to nearby Business Hubs.

5 min: Piercy Priest boat dock
7: Super Speedway
15: Long Hunter State Park, Cedars of Lebanon
20: Wilson County Fairground
25: BNA airport 
35: Nashville downtown

The space
Fully Furnished, New barndominium in the front section of a barn. Includes a full kitchen, with an island that has seating for 4. 
Living room has lots of seating, push button electric recliner, and a sleeper sofa. Bedroom includes a motorized head raise queen bed, desk, and walk in closet. Large bathroom with cozy towels, toiletries, and an entrance to a  laundry room. 
Enjoy rustic farmhouse charm throughout and a spacious front porch with a beautiful  view during your relaxing stay! It’s not unusual to see deer, wild turkeys, and rabbits in addition to our little goats.

Guest access
You can enjoy the entire farmhouse suite, front porch, and fire pit next to the fence. Feel free to stand at the fence to watch the goats.

Feel free to bring your boat or trailer.  Plenty of parking in the circle driveway or to side of barndominium

Other things to note
Please turn in driveway with the 260 address sign. Aloha Goats Farm sign is posted at the entrance of barndominium driveway. You can park in the circular driveway. Plan to relax and unwind on our peaceful farm.
